scope: Two new pinned-image metadata module/test files
One guarded session method and added focused tests
Maintained lifecycle RFC and sanitized evidence

review.kind: Release-engineering preparation plus independent primary source/AST review

limitations: Synthetic metadata, fake framed sockets and guarded-session tests only; no live collector, image execution, guest admission or lifecycle acceptance.
Only thirteen reviewed Config fields are accepted. Unknown fields refuse; Config is bounded to 64KiB serialized, 256-entry arrays/maps, 4KiB strings, depth8 and 4096 nodes.
Matching exact pin/platform/Config projections detect sampled drift but cannot exclude transient changes or reserve the engine. Mutable repository tags/digests are not content identity.
The shared deadline bounds HTTP work, not arbitrary filesystem syscalls. Operation locks remain advisory.
Image volume/healthcheck/OnBuild declarations are facts, not compatibility approval or absence of anonymous runtime volumes. ArgsEscaped=true has no Linux safety ruling.
Metadata does not inspect filesystem contents, execute Python, establish supply-chain trust, attribute retained resources or prove volume continuity.

Secure materialization, durable auxiliary persistence, exact creation-receipt attribution, retained-volume continuity/restart reconciliation, context-aware lifecycle and the full recovery harness remain unfinished.
Disconnected VM/console, operator working-fixture replacement scope, physical/material/runtime admission, global release/lint, H7/W16, Coordinator and private-backup gates remain open.
